assay_evidence.finding: A vendor validation example reports less than four-fold Kd variation for one compound-kinase pair over six months and three compound lots.
assay_evidence.limitation: One pair is not a repeat-error distribution; 0.60206 log10 units is contextual span only and is forbidden as a model-gain threshold.

assay_evidence.finding: KIRHub reports R-squared 0.99 for duplicate one-micromolar residual-activity screens.
assay_evidence.limitation: The public matrix contains averages, not paired repeats; correlation does not identify paired error magnitude.

assay_evidence.finding: OKL repeated selected problematic batches and retained raw multi-dose measurements.
assay_evidence.limitation: QC-triggered repeats are not an unbiased technical-repeat sample for Davis exact Kd metrics.

frozen_estimation_procedure.minimum_repeat_design: Same standardized ligand parent and exact assay construct, independent assay preparation/batch, raw unaveraged results, stratified across potency/censor regions and both leakage-component axes.
frozen_estimation_procedure.rule: At the final admitted panel size, repeatedly swap replicate A/B labels within the same assayed pair and apply the frozen paired multiway scaffold-target-component bootstrap. For each metric, the practical-equivalence half-width is the 95th percentile of the absolute metric contrast attributable only to replicate choice. Estimate and freeze these metric-specific regions before any model outcomes are inspected.

reason_numeric_region_blocked: No public source provides a representative raw paired-repeat distribution for the Davis KINOMEscan exact-Kd estimand.
